systems.platform: A digital application on tablets, working offline and transmitting to an online platform and central database; developed with UNICEF support. No product named.
systems.owner: Ministry of Education, through its Cabinet for Studies, Planning and Statistics (GEPE); the pilot implemented by the Provincial Government of Huíla with UNICEF technical and financial support
systems.tiers: Pilot in Huíla province: 28 trained technicians, two per municipality, visited all 1,843 primary and secondary schools in 14 municipalities and keyed a questionnaire answered by the principal; data used at local, provincial and national level. Extension to all provinces planned once funds are secured.

note: No fact: SIGE as described is a per-school questionnaire of counts and school features (pupils and teachers per course, classes, electricity, water), entered by a visiting technician and feeding the Annual Education Report, so it is a census; the document describes no per-learner record and no entry by the school. It says school statistics were until then collected by paper survey, which is about the census return, not learners' records.
